literal: Than themselves, their children's possession of wisdom, to all abiding lives of the great earth, is sweet.
translation: That their children possess wisdom is a greater joy to all living beings on this vast earth than it is to the parents themselves.
modern: தம்முடைய பிள்ளைகள் அறிவுடையவர்களாக இருப்பது, பெற்றோராகிய தங்களை விடவும் இப்பெரிய உலகத்தில் வாழும் அனைத்து உயிர்களுக்கும் மிகுந்த மகிழ்ச்சி தருவதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the universal benefit of raising wise children. While parents naturally feel proud of their children's wisdom ('அறிவுடைமை'), the poet states that this wisdom brings even greater joy ('இனிது') to the rest of the world. The phrase 'மாநிலத்து மன்னுயிர்க்கு எல்லாம்' emphasizes that a wise person's life and intellect serve and please all living beings on this vast earth, extending the impact of good parenting far beyond the immediate family.
